title: Evaluating AI-Powered Learning Assistants in Engineering Higher Education: Student Engagement, Ethical Challenges, and Policy Implications
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The study evaluated student engagement, ethical challenges, and policy implications of an AI-powered learning assistant in engineering education.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the use of AI in engineering higher education.
